senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. עָוָה) to be curved, crooked.

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>מתוך כך … ומְעַוְּותִין את הדין</he> in consequence (of drinking) they cause the Law to be forgotten, and they pervert judgment.

Nidd. 10ᵇ אין בודקות … מפני שמְעַוְּותוֹת אותן (not בודקין) they (the women) must not examine them (the young girls) with the fingers, because they may corrupt them (teach them unnatural gratification; Rashi: they may wound them).—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:15:2">Koh. R. to I, 15</cite> (ref. to <he>מעות</he> <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:15:2">ib.</cite>) <he>אם אין אדם מְעַוֵּות עצמו מדברי תורה וכ׳</he> as long as a person (though doing wrong) does not pervert himself through wilful misinterpretation of the Law, there is a remedy for him; <he>משאדם מעוות וכ׳</he> but as soon as a person perverts himself &c.; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Niddah 12b:12">Nidd. 12ᵇ</cite> (adapting Koh. l. c.) <he>הן עִוְּתוּהָ הן תקנוה</he> they make her crooked (the evidence on the cloths will make her unfit for marital intercourse), and they make her straight (if the evidence is favorable).

senses.gloss: to offend, excite displeasure; wound the feelings of.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a:9">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>יְעַיֵּת</he>; <cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Zuta 10:1">Der. Er. Zut. ch. X</cite> <he>יְעַוֵּות</he> shall be offensive, v. <cite ref="A02062"><he>אָמַר</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:23">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 78</cite> <he>אע״פ … מְעַוְּתִים אותי וכ׳</he> although the wicked insult me, I do not abandon the Law.

Sifré Deut. 1; Yalk. ib. 792 למה אתה מְעַוֵּות עלינו וכ׳ why dost thou make the Scriptures loathsome to us (by absurd interpretations)?—Part. pass. מְעֻוָּת, מְעוּוָּת; f. מְעוֶּוּתֶת; pl. מְעוּוָּתִים, מְעוּוָּתִין; מְעִוּוָּתוֹת, מְעֻוָּ׳ crooked, perverted, perverse. Koh. R. l. c. בעולם הזה מי שהוא מע׳ וכ׳ in this world, he who is crooked may be straightened again (a sinner may amend his ways) &c.

Ex. R. s. 2, beg. (ref. to עלילות, Ps. CIII, 7, in contrast to Deut. XXII, 14) [read:] בשר ודם עלילותיו מע׳ וכ׳ the ʿăliloth (machinations) of man are perverse …, but the ʿăliloth (dispositions) of the Lord are merciful; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be curved, wrested; to be perverted; to deteriorate. Koh. R. l. c. אין קורין מעוות … ונ׳ we do not call a thing perverted, unless it was at a time straight (right), and it became curved. Ib. משנִתְעַיְּותוּ המים וכ׳ when the waters dating from creation became deteriorated.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 41b:7">Sot. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>נִתְעַוְּותוּ הדינין</he> (or <he>הדַּיָּנִין</he>, v. Rashi a. l.) the courts became depraved.
<cite ref="Sotah 47b:17">Ib. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>נתעוותו הדינין</he> justice became corrupt; (Tosef. ib. XIV, 3 <he>נתקלקל הדין</he>).
